title: Interest forecast failed [Beta]
description: This event occurs when an interest forecast requested with POST /v1/interest/forecast cannot be calculated with product interest engine. The event is delivered at least once, so the same failure can be received more than once: use forecast_id to discard duplicates. The optional fields division_id and external_account_id are present only when informed in the request.

forecast_id.title: Forecast ID
forecast_id.description: Client-generated forecast UUID in the hyphenated 36-character format (8-4-4-4-12), in lowercase.

org_id.title: Organization ID
org_id.description: Organization ID, parsed from the access token of the forecast request.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Program ID of the forecast request.

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Division identifier informed in the request.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan ID identifier
interest_plan_id.description: Interest plan ID informed in the request.

forecast_date.title: Forecast date
forecast_date.description: Date the forecast was requested for, as informed in the request. Absent when the forecast_date of the request cannot be read. Format = YYYY-MM-DD.

message.title: Error message
message.description: Description of the error that prevented the forecast from being calculated.
examples: The provided forecast_id has already been used.
No interest base was found for the account.
No active interest configuration was found for the account or interest plan.
No active benchmark rate was found for the interest configuration.
The forecast could not be processed due to a temporary error.
The forecast could not be processed.
